subject: Business Models
title: Antitrust and Platforms
description: A quick win: understand Antitrust and Platforms.

hook.text: The EU fined Google $8.2 billion across three antitrust cases. The biggest tech penalties in history.

buildup.text: Antitrust law was built for industrial monopolies. Platform monopolies don't fit neatly into old frameworks.

discovery.text: Platforms often offer free or cheap products. Traditional antitrust focuses on high prices as consumer harm.

twist.text: The harm may be to competition, not consumers. Amazon's low prices hurt rivals more than customers.

climax.text: Regulators worldwide are rewriting rules. The EU's Digital Markets Act specifically targets platform gatekeepers.

punchline.text: Free products, massive power. Old antitrust law didn't see this coming.

quiz.question: Why don't platforms fit traditional antitrust frameworks?
options: They often offer free/cheap products despite having monopoly power
